qualification: ITI Electrician, ITI Fitter and More – 100 Posts
salary: The stipend is paid monthly, shared between NCL (25%) and the Government of Madhya Pradesh (75%), and is paid as per the applicable MMSKY provisions and guidelines. || The contributions of NCL and the Government of Madhya Pradesh are regulated as per the scheme guidelines. selection_process: Applications received against the training opportunities published by NCL will be scrutinised as per the prescribed eligibility conditions. || Eligible candidates may be called for an interview/interaction online, by telephone or by another suitable means, as per the scheme provisions. || Shortlisted candidates may be called to a designated place for document verification and further joining formalities. || Final selection will be made by NCL as per the applicable MMSKY provisions and guidelines. || Selection is subject to verification of eligibility and approval of the training contract by the competent authority on the MMSKY portal. Merely submitting an application gives no right to selection or training.
